about_short_description.short_description: Newsela is an Ed-tech startup that takes content from trusted providers and turns it into learning materials.

product.name: Newsela ELA
product.description: A digital English language arts resource with differentiated texts, novel studies, curriculum complements, quizzes, and standards-aligned activities for literacy instruction.

product.name: Newsela Social Studies
product.description: A digital social studies resource featuring primary sources, biographies, current events, multimedia, and standards-aligned activities for historical and civic learning.

product.name: Newsela STEM
product.description: A science and STEM instruction resource combining standards-aligned texts, videos, lessons, activities, simulations, and data sets to connect literacy with scientific concepts.

product.name: Balanced Assessment by Formative
product.description: A district assessment platform for creating and delivering standards-aligned assessments, monitoring student responses in real time, and using performance data to guide instruction.

product.name: Newsela Writing
product.description: A digital writing practice and feedback tool that provides real-time, rubric-aligned guidance to help students revise and improve writing across subjects.

product.name: Schoolytics
product.description: A student-data analytics platform that combines academic, behavioral, and attendance information into dashboards and reports for school and district decision-making.
